items.label: As built: eighth circle (its blow the drum-like kick)
Air blast (displaced air flaring open and closing - no pitch)
Soft bloom (the blast with a slower attack: a surge, not a hit)
Sub bloom (pressure without a beater: a deep tone swelling in, no falling pitch)
Concussion (a dark, driven burst of low air, a muffled blast far off)
Shatter of air (soft fragments overlapping, no single attack)
Sub drop only (the falling weight, smooth, no noise on top)
No impact (the whoomph alone, its peak sharpened to be the moment)
Air blast + sub bloom (air and weight, still no beater)
